title: Contour terrain
description: Slowly shifting elevation bands carve warm paper into a layered topographic relief.
useCase: Outdoor identities, geography stories, architecture portfolios, or an editorial cover with dimensional texture.
interaction: Play or pause the material study.
reducedMotion: Displays one stable, representative frame. Responds immediately when the system preference changes.
limitations: Requires WebGL 1; a static CSS composition remains visible when WebGL is unavailable or lost. A generative relief, not geographic data. Contour edges redraw in the fragment shader.
look: Burnt-orange field of cream contour lines ringing a pale peak, faint crosshair grid marks, a cream monospace label bar and a serif headline on rust.
motion: The terrain drifts on slow sine offsets (periods about 37 and 48 s), so contour bands continuously creep and reshape; a pause button stops the loop.
adapt: All motion is the `terrain` function in `FRAGMENT`: tune its `u_time` multipliers for drift speed, the Gaussian hills for shape and `altitude * 15.0` for band count; `orange` and `sand` set the palette. Replace the overlay copy.
